notes: 1979 zoning sheet 11. No rule on the top, left or right: map ink runs into the top page edge (row 0) and is cut at x ~25 on the left and x ~2790 on the right with blank paper beyond, so those sides follow the page edge (rule 5). Bottom: ~2 px above the thick bar that rules off the legend strip; the bar is tilted and stair-stepped (top edge y ~3380 at the left, ~3341 at x 2530, ending at x ~2743 where 'SHEE 11' starts below it); its line is carried on out to the right page edge (y ~3319 there) and the left page edge, as in 1980-1990-zoning-p01. No arcs, no notches, no remove polygon (north arrow, scale bar and sheet number are in the legend strip, outside). JOHN McLAREN PARK and district codes are map. No ink under the outline.
